blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has extended its 14-day visa-free entry privilege for Chinese nationals for another year, allowing them to visit the country for tourism and business until Jan. 15, 2028, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) announced on Monday. The extension, which will take effect from Jan. 16, 2027, is in line with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s directive to increase international tourist arrivals and attract more investments while maintaining immigration and national security safeguards, the DFA said.
